natural: in the full prime of one's years

meaning.en: In the prime of life, with many vigorous years still ahead.
meaning.zh: 正当壮年，来日方长，形容年纪轻、精力旺盛。

examples.zh: 他春秋鼎盛，正是干一番事业的时候。
examples.en: He is in his prime, just the right time to build a career.

examples.zh: 这位春秋鼎盛的教授又拿了一项大奖。
examples.en: This professor, still in his prime, has won yet another major prize.

examples.zh: 老师说，你们春秋鼎盛，要好好利用时间。
examples.en: The teacher said, 'You are in your prime, so make good use of your time.'

story.en: Jia Yi writes that the emperor is 'in the full prime of his years' (天子春秋鼎盛), praising a ruler's youth and vigour.
story.zh: 《汉书·贾谊传》：“天子春秋鼎盛，行义未过，德泽有加焉。”

usage.en: Used of a person's age, never of things. 春秋 means 'years of age'. Literary; do not use of someone who is already old.
usage.zh: 指人的年龄，不用于事物；春秋指年岁。书面语，不可用于老年人。

meaning.en: Spring is drawing to a close and its charm is fading.
meaning.zh: 春天将尽，春天的气息渐渐衰减。

examples.zh: 春意阑珊，满地都是落花。
examples.en: Spring was waning, and fallen petals covered the ground.

examples.zh: 暮春时节，公园里已是春意阑珊。
examples.en: In late spring, the park already felt the season slipping away.

examples.zh: 诗人在春意阑珊的黄昏里写下了这首词。
examples.en: The poet wrote this lyric on a dusk when spring was fading.

usage.en: Poetic, often tinged with a sense of loss or nostalgia. Used as a predicate or attributive in descriptive writing.
usage.zh: 诗意较浓，常带惜春、感伤的情绪，多作谓语、定语。

natural: visit a friend on a snowy night

meaning.en: To act on a sudden impulse and turn back at the door, content with the journey itself; also, a warm, spontaneous visit to a friend.
meaning.zh: 随兴而往、兴尽而返；也指雪夜访友，表现名士的洒脱。

examples.zh: 这次说走就走的旅行，兴尽而返，颇有雪夜访戴之风。
examples.en: Like Wang Huizhi on his snowy night, they dropped in late and talked until dawn.

examples.zh: 这次说走就走的旅行，颇有几分雪夜访戴的意味。
examples.en: This spur-of-the-moment trip had something of the snowy-night visit about it.

story.en: Wang Huizhi, waking to snow, suddenly longed to see his friend Dai Kui, sailed all night, then turned back at his door: 'I went on a whim and left when the whim was spent; why must I see Dai?'
story.zh: 《世说新语·任诞》：王子猷夜雪忽忆戴安道，乘小船连夜前往，至门不前而返，曰：“吾本乘兴而行，兴尽而返，何必见戴？”

usage.en: An allusion to Wang Huizhi's visit to Dai Kui. Literary and cultured; usually hints at free-spirited, unhurried elegance rather than literal snow.
usage.zh: 典故，用于文雅场合，多暗指率性洒脱的名士风度，未必真有雪夜。

natural: threads of rain and wisps of wind

meaning.en: Fine drizzle carried on a light breeze, a poetic image of gentle spring weather.
meaning.zh: 细雨如丝，微风片片，形容春天里轻柔的风雨。

examples.zh: 雨丝风片中，我们撑着伞慢慢走过石桥。
examples.en: Through the drizzle and the breeze we walked slowly over the stone bridge.

examples.zh: 江南的春天总是雨丝风片，润物无声。
examples.en: Spring in Jiangnan is all fine rain and gentle wind, moistening things silently.

story.en: The phrase appears in Tang Xianzu's opera: 'Threads of rain, wisps of wind, mist on the water, a painted boat' (雨丝风片，烟波画船).
story.zh: 汤显祖《牡丹亭·惊梦》：“雨丝风片，烟波画船，锦屏人忒看的这韶光贱。”

usage.en: Purely descriptive and poetic; rare in speech. Often cited for its use in the opera The Peony Pavilion.
usage.zh: 纯描写性、诗意的词语，口语少用，因《牡丹亭》而知名。

natural: rain and dew reach everyone alike

meaning.en: Everyone gets a share of the benefits, just as rain and dew fall on all plants.
meaning.zh: 像雨露滋润万物那样，每个人都能得到好处。

examples.zh: 奖学金要做到雨露均沾，不能总给同几个人。
examples.en: Scholarships should go round fairly, not always to the same few.

examples.zh: 这次扶贫款项雨露均沾，每个村子都有份。
examples.en: The poverty-relief funds were shared out evenly, and every village got something.

usage.en: Often used about favours, subsidies or credit being distributed. Sometimes ironic, hinting at everyone taking a cut.
usage.zh: 多指恩惠、利益普遍分配；有时带讽刺意味，暗指人人都分一杯羹。

literal: rosy cloud · light · ten thousand · rays

meaning.en: Rays of colourful light stream from the clouds at sunrise or sunset.
meaning.zh: 朝霞或晚霞放射出万缕光芒，景象壮丽。

examples.zh: 清晨，霞光万道，海面一片金红。
examples.en: At dawn, rays of light streamed out and the sea turned gold and red.

examples.zh: 我们爬上山顶，等着看霞光万道的日出。
examples.en: We climbed to the summit to watch the sunrise flood the sky with colour.

usage.en: Common in descriptive writing and school compositions about sunrise and sunset. Usually the subject or opening clause.
usage.zh: 常见于描写日出日落的作文，多作主语或分句。

natural: the setting sun like molten gold

meaning.en: The setting sun glows like molten gold.
meaning.zh: 落日像熔化的金子一样红亮灿烂。

examples.zh: 落日熔金，湖面上闪着耀眼的光。
examples.en: The sun melted into gold and the lake shimmered dazzlingly.

examples.zh: 她拍下了落日熔金的一瞬间。
examples.en: She captured the moment when the setting sun turned to molten gold.

story.en: Li Qingzhao's lyric opens: 'The setting sun melts like gold, the evening clouds close like jade' (落日熔金，暮云合璧).
story.zh: 李清照《永遇乐·落日熔金》：“落日熔金，暮云合璧，人在何处。”

usage.en: A vivid sunset image, literary in tone. Often paired with 暮云合璧 in the original line.
usage.zh: 描写日落的优美意象，书面语，原句常与“暮云合璧”相对。

meaning.en: To have no clear idea of the real situation; not to know what to expect.
meaning.zh: 对情况不了解，心里没有底。

equivalents: have no idea where things stand

examples.zh: 考试前我心中无数，不知道会考什么。
examples.en: Before the exam I had no idea what would come up.

examples.zh: 对市场行情心中无数，就不要贸然投资。
examples.en: Don't invest rashly if you have no feel for the market.

examples.zh: 他对这个项目的进度心中无数。
examples.en: He has no clear picture of how the project is going.

usage.en: Predicate. The opposite is 心中有数. Neutral register, common in both speech and writing.
usage.zh: 作谓语。反义为“心中有数”。口语书面语都常用。

meaning.en: So dazzled by something splendid that one feels giddy and entranced.
meaning.zh: 被眼前美好或繁杂的景象迷住，头晕眼花，心神恍惚。

examples.zh: 烟花绽放，孩子们看得目眩神迷。
examples.en: The fireworks burst open and the children watched, spellbound.

examples.zh: 初到大都市，他被满街的霓虹灯弄得目眩神迷。
examples.en: New to the big city, he was dazzled by the neon lights everywhere.

examples.zh: 名画展让游客目眩神迷。
examples.en: The exhibition of famous paintings left visitors dazzled.

usage.en: Predicate or complement, as in 看得目眩神迷. Can be positive (wonder) or mildly negative (overwhelmed).
usage.zh: 多作谓语或补语，如“看得目眩神迷”。可表惊叹，也可略含被迷惑之意。

natural: face the wall and reflect on one's faults

meaning.en: To reflect quietly on one's mistakes, as if sent to face a wall.
meaning.zh: 面对墙壁反省自己的过错；泛指认真反省。

equivalents: sit and reflect on one's mistakes

examples.zh: 你先回房间面壁思过，想想哪里做错了。
examples.en: Go to your room and think about what you did wrong.

examples.zh: 犯了错的球员被罚面壁思过一周。
examples.en: The player who erred was told to spend a week reflecting on his mistake.

usage.en: Often used with humour about a scolded child or a punished colleague. Associated with the monk Bodhidharma's wall-gazing, but the idiom means self-reproach.
usage.zh: 常用于戏谑地指犯错者被罚反省。与达摩面壁相关，但成语义为自我检讨。

natural: point out the rivers and mountains

meaning.en: To comment freely and confidently on state affairs or great matters.
meaning.zh: 评论国家大事，或对大局发表自己的见解，气势豪迈。

equivalents: hold forth on affairs of state
survey the realm and give one's views

examples.zh: 他喜欢在茶馆里指点江山，谈论天下大事。
examples.en: He likes to hold forth on world affairs in the teahouse.

examples.zh: 青年人要敢于指点江山，更要脚踏实地。
examples.en: Young people should dare to speak out on great matters, and also stay down to earth.

examples.zh: 这位将军站在地图前指点江山。
examples.en: The general stood before the map, surveying the land with sweeping gestures.

usage.en: Can be admiring (grand vision) or mocking (armchair strategists). Often with 激扬文字 in Mao Zedong's line 指点江山，激扬文字.
usage.zh: 可褒可贬：褒指气魄宏大，贬指空谈。常与“激扬文字”连用。

natural: point at heaven and swear by the sun

meaning.en: To swear a solemn oath, pointing to heaven and the sun as witnesses.
meaning.zh: 指着天、对着太阳发誓，形容誓言郑重坚决。

examples.zh: 他指天誓日地保证绝不再迟到。
examples.en: He swore solemnly that he would never be late again.

examples.zh: 他指天誓日说钱不是他拿的。
examples.en: He swore on his life that he had not taken the money.

usage.en: Usually followed by a promise or denial that may turn out false, so it can carry doubt. Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 所发誓言往往后来并不可信，因而常带怀疑色彩。作谓语、状语。

natural: teeth like a string of shells

meaning.en: Teeth that are white and evenly set, like a row of strung shells.
meaning.zh: 牙齿洁白整齐，像一串贝壳。

examples.zh: 她唇红齿白，齿如编贝，笑起来十分好看。
examples.en: With red lips and teeth like a string of pearls, her smile was lovely.

examples.zh: 小说里的少年郎君齿如编贝，唇若涂朱。
examples.en: The young hero in the novel has even white teeth and lips red as paint.

story.en: Dongfang Shuo boasts in his self-recommendation of 'teeth like strung shells' (齿若编贝) among his talents.
story.zh: 《汉书·东方朔传》：东方朔自荐曰：“目若悬珠，齿若编贝。”

usage.en: A literary compliment on someone's looks, usually in descriptions of beauties in old-style writing. Used as a predicate.
usage.zh: 文雅的外貌赞语，多见于旧式描写美人的文字。作谓语。
